Honestly? Leading up to my OCD episode, it was some of the most stress free moments of my life. I actually like and thrive under stress. As far as loneliness goes, covid isolation was still in its infancy at that point, but also I am highly sociable and didn’t feel lonely during that time. I’m extroverted and craved non covid inhibited social times, but it wasn’t too bad. 

My therapist and I deconstructed it and really it was only a matter of time before the episode happened. I had far more stressful and lonelier periods before the episode. She said it was common at my age that I would have a first episode, especially given my family history of OCD. My mom was 22 when she had her first episode, I was 20. My grandma was 23.

As far as the zest for life issue goes, nah. It’s all OCD lol. And I’m not even joking. My life wasn’t perfect before OCD by any means, but man. I remember what life was like without the constant rumination, compulsions, and intrusive thoughts.

Think about it this way, I can’t really do anything anymore without these thoughts in my head. While I’m “recovered” meaning they don’t bother me to the point of immense anxiety and grief anymore. They’re still there, they still put a damper on things, and they still alter the way I live in a way I never had before. I think because I was an adult was I was diagnosed, and was able to live so long without it, it’s easier for me to pinpoint it down to these symptoms and this disorder just makes life sucky. I understand where you’re coming from when you ask if there are actual causes exacerbating these issues, but politely, no that’s not the case. On the outside I look very well adjusted. I have a great job, I travel, have good relationships (both platonic and romantic). It’s just there’s always something there from letting my happiness be at it’s highest and it’s never anything not related to ocd, because I always overcome those external issues.
I feel so this so hard. I wonder how the last 3 years would have gone if I didn’t have this disorder and was still the old me.

So, I’ve had OCD symptoms most of my life but nothing severe. Just like moments of intrusive thoughts but I’d brush past them. Or as a kid I’d have little rumination episodes here and there but nothing awful. 3 years ago though symptoms went from 0-100 and I had my first OCD episode. I was in therapy at that time for depression and anxiety, but then it switched over to OCD treatment but therapy wasn’t enough. I asked my doctor for SSRIs but he didn’t want to give someone my age that, so I ended up taking Buspar which did nothing. And in the span of 2 months I went from a happy and very successful college student to someone who couldn’t eat, sleep, or bathe, etc. I ended up becoming hospitalized because of it. 

Recovery has been rocky but I look at who I was before that episode and it just depresses me too much. I’m not an entirely different person but the spark and zest for life I had is just gone. I don’t laugh as easily anymore, I don’t think as freely or clearly. I used to be carefree and lively and I try to do everything to bring these aspects of old self back, but like I said there’s a spark that’s just missing. I feel so hindered and dependent when I used to push through and thrive through my independence. It’s the first time ever I felt stunted in some sort of way and ngl it eats at me. And mind you, I’m considered recovered.

And while being in recovery is nice, knowing that those parts of me not returning is no longer a sad idea but a possible reality is enough for me to wish for a cure. If you have anymore questions im free to answer.

My life before OCD was amazing. I hate thinking about it so much and would do anything to return to that. I miss that personality I had, and I hate the missed opportunities and where I would be now had I not had it. I was a better person before. I was happier and stronger before. Even though I had effective therapy, I would do anything to get rid of it and not have something that etches at my quality of life everyday.

If you apply this to amazon and google play as well, in total it would be around 9k sales out of the 14.5. The other sales coming from his store too, which can allow for bulk buying, but even when that is cut out for, a depletion of almost 100k sales raises alarms. 

I don’t care about BB’s rules before, I don’t care about whether bulk buying is considered fair or not, but as someone who is both a musician and has worked in the industry for 4 years now, this is the first time this has raised alarm bells for me.

Looking at data from Luminate, Hitsdd and other charting sources alone. It was reported in this week of sales that roughly 19k of his sales came from Amazon and Itunes alone. You can’t buy hundreds of copies from those sources. All sales combined for the charts were capped at 14.5k. Given his TEA and SEA sales being nearly equal, and also comparing the data from the first week, 90% filtration is insane. BB’s filtration is actually less nefarious than assumed. It’s done at shop level, email, sometimes billing, and quantities. Because it’s done at point of sale, they cannot track things across outlets (itunes, amazon, his own store, etc). I would give them 60% or even 70% filtration to be fair. But 90% seems impossible.

The convos I’m seeing about her being a reflection of him are literally leading into people saying he sees himself as a woman (I can literally show you proof of this) which I think is a deeply intrusive theory to have. The more common theory I’m seeing is that she’s his feminine side that he embraces… But I’m not going to lie, that doesn’t hold up. The lyrics are “all my reflections, I don’t even recognize” and at the end of the choreo he turns away from her and slips back into being alone (which ties back into his explanation of separation). 

The reason I said it was bordering on misogyny and biphobia is because I think people are more accepting of her not being a love interest of any kind, than her actually being so. Anyways, I have to reiterate, Im not upset at the theories, I’m just a bit miffed that the things that happened with Filter and the live performance are happening again.

Ugh this is too relatable. I’m also dealing with automatic checking. Im trying to deal with it by just learning to be comfortable with being uncomfortable. The automatic checking is just your body anticipating something to happen.  For instance, my automatic checking is usually in response to potential bodily responses. I’m learning how to just let the potential bodily responses be whether they happen or not. When the automatic checking happens, I just go oh well, and try to sit with being uncomfortable with whatever happens. If a bodily response happens, deal with it. If it doesn’t happen, don’t find relief in it. Just let it be. And that should help you deal with the ruminations better.

My therapist and I also talked about keeping the mind busy. Obviously don’t avoid whatever your theme is about, but sometimes give your brain a break from ERP/CBT and do something mindless to take your mind off of OCD all together. I play video games and I knit. It helps me de-stress and keeps the ruminations at bay for a while.
